source: Kotzias, D. (2015). Sentiment Labelled Sentences. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C57604; IMDB subset, plus 12 original atlas challenge probes.
license: UCI rows: CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ ; original probes: repository MIT. Preserve attribution.
changes: Subset, two unlabelled physical-line continuations joined with spaces, canonical exact-duplicate removal, deterministic stratified hash splits; sentence text otherwise preserved. Original probes separately identified.
split: 200 train / 40 validation / 80 test UCI sentences (balanced); 12 separate original challenge probes.
leakagePolicy: Fit vectorizer/head/prototypes on train only; choose regularization and review threshold on validation only. Test identical across methods. Canonical text unique across all splits. Pretrained-model data overlap is unknown; this is not a contamination-free benchmark.
